concepts.label: CPI-U: all items
concepts.notes: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers, all items, U.S. city average. NSA counterpart is CPIAUCNS.

concepts.label: CPI-U: all items less food and energy
concepts.notes: Core CPI-U. Food and energy stripped because of volatility; not a cost-of-living claim for households that spend on those items.

concepts.label: Civilian unemployment rate
concepts.notes: Household survey (CPS) U-3 rate. NSA counterpart is UNRATENSA. Not the same as U-6 or insured unemployment.

concepts.label: All employees, total nonfarm
concepts.notes: Establishment survey (CES). Subject to annual benchmark revisions. NSA counterpart is PAYNSA.

concepts.label: Average hourly earnings, total private
concepts.notes: CES average hourly earnings of all employees, total private. Nominal dollars. NSA counterpart is CEU0500000003. Deflate explicitly (CPI-U or PCE) before calling this real wages.

concepts.label: Real gross domestic product
concepts.notes: BEA NIPA real GDP, seasonally adjusted annual rate. Advance / second / third vintages differ; this id is the latest vintage, not ALFRED.

concepts.label: Federal funds effective rate
concepts.notes: Monthly average of the daily effective federal funds rate. Not seasonally adjusted. Target range is a different series (DFEDTARU / DFEDTARL).

concepts.label: Housing starts, total new privately owned
concepts.notes: Census New Residential Construction. Seasonally adjusted annual rate. NSA counterpart is HOUSTNSA.

concepts.label: 10-year Treasury constant maturity
concepts.notes: Market yield on U.S. Treasury securities at 10-year constant maturity. Daily, not seasonally adjusted. Weekend/holiday gaps are expected.

concepts.label: PCE chain-type price index
concepts.notes: BEA PCE price index, the FOMC's preferred inflation gauge. Not CPI-U. Headline; core is PCEPILFE.

concepts.label: ACS median household income
concepts.notes: American Community Survey table B19013, estimate B19013_001E. Not a FRED series. Choose 1-year vs 5-year and vintage explicitly. Nominal dollars; Census inflation-adjusts some published comparisons — do not assume that here.

concepts.label: ACS employment status, population 16+
concepts.notes: American Community Survey table B23025 (employment status). Universe is civilian / 16+ — confirm the line (total, in labor force, employed, unemployed) before charting. Not CPS UNRATE and not monthly.
